name: Weak Label Generation via SegFormer
definition: Generates weak 3D point labels for unlabeled driving data by training a SegFormer model on a mixture of external datasets (Cityscapes, Mapillary, BDD, IDD) and applying label merging strategies for cross-dataset generalization.
summary: Weak Label Generation via SegFormer produces 3D point labels for unlabeled driving data using pre-trained foundation models, distinguishing itself by enabling annotation-free segmentation through feature-level distribution alignment.
